subject: Strategic accommodation request — model availability gap affecting go-live
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@kestrelhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Rodriguez <alex.rodriguez@kestrelhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood integration — go-live impact and next steps

Hi Kimberly,

Quick update from our side — the engineering team just finished their final integration pass and discovered that the specific model variant we validated in the pilot (rwd-large-2-8k) will not be available in their region until mid-June due to scheduled maintenance and hardware allocation conflicts. That means our production cutover planned for May 29 will need to be pushed or we need a commercial accommodation to keep the original economics while we roll a compatible fallback.

The launch timelines (attached) show customer demos planned starting June 3; postponing will materially affect our sales cycles and onboard costs. From a procurement/exec perspective they are asking if Redwood can provide a one-time commercial adjustment (credit or discount) tied to the model availability gap while we wait for the recommended variant.

Can you advise on process and whether we should loop in finance? We want to avoid escalating to their CFO if possible but need a clear, timely response.

Thanks — Samira

--
Samira Khan
Head of Integrations, Kestrel Health
samira.khan@kestrelhealth.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood integration — go-live impact and next steps

Ben / Karthik — forwarding Samira's note. Kestrel is asking for a commercial accommodation due to our recommended model variant not being available in their region until mid-June. They specifically asked for a one-time credit to preserve the original economics while they wait for the validated model.

Quick asks:
- Product: is there an acceptable fallback model variant we can force-route them to that preserves functional parity? Any quality delta we should disclose?
- Sales: what's a reasonable commercial accommodation here (credits vs temporary discounted rate)? They are an early enterprise and strategic reference for our healthcare vertical.
- Finance: are there guardrails / thresholds for one-off credits vs exec approvals?

I attached Kestrel's timeline and our internal integration notes. I'd like to respond to Samira within 24 hours with a proposed path.

Thanks — Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 12:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood integration — go-live impact and next steps

Kim / Ben — read and thanks for the heads up. Short answer: there is an immediate fallback (rwd-large-2-4k-quant) that we can route them to with minimal infra changes. In our internal perf tests the fallback has ~5-8% lower rouge/semantic-match on longer prompts for our healthcare prompts, and latency is comparable.

My recommendation: technically safe to route, but we should be explicit with Kestrel about the quality delta and offer the fallback as a stopgap. For commercial accommodation, a short-term credit that covers the incremental customer churn/re-demo risk makes sense — perhaps 20% of forecasted May usage or a fixed $X credit. From product side we'd also prioritize getting the validated variant into the region; status today is "on track" for 18 June unless we reallocate capacity.

I can draft a short technical note summarizing the expected delta and mitigation steps for the customer-facing message.

—Karthik

On Mon, May 20, 2028 at 10:05 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Ben / Karthik — forwarding Samira's note....

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood integration — go-live impact and next steps

Team — propose the following commercial path for an expedited customer response:
1) Offer a temporary 30% credit on May invoice up to $25k as a gesture of goodwill tied explicitly to the model availability gap. This is time-boxed (one invoice period) and conditioned on Kestrel accepting the fallback variant and our credit note.
2) Provide the fallback technical note from Karthik and offer a joint call with our engineering lead to walk through the expected behavior and re-demo plan.

Rationale: the customer's revenue influence in the healthcare space and reference value justify a one-off credit at this size; it keeps the launch cadence and limits churn risk. If finance objects to $25k cap we can lower to $15k.

Marissa — need quick guidance on whether a $25k one-off credit requires exec sign-off or if you can approve from finance.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood integration — go-live impact and next steps

Ben — thanks. Finance can approve up to $10k in promotional credits at my discretion for deals under $200k ARR. For anything above that threshold (or when credits are to be applied retroactively to invoices), we need a commercial exception approved by Sales Leadership (Laura) + a note to Legal for our revenue recognition treatment.

If we go with the $25k proposal we need Laura to sign off and Legal looped in. If you want to keep this under finance-only territory, reduce to $10k and route as a promotional credit with standard GL coding.

I'll also need a short rationale memo that includes: expected lift in retention / demo outcomes, why the credit is timeboxed, and confirmation they will accept the fallback variant. I can draft the memo template if you want.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations & Finance, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 May 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood integration — go-live impact and next steps

All — I hear the ask and I approve a one-time commercial accommodation of up to $20k for Kestrel Health, provided the following conditions are met: (1) Kestrel signs the attached acceptance of the fallback model and an acknowledgment of the quality delta, (2) the credit is applied to the May invoice as a one-off promotional credit, (3) Legal confirms the revenue treatment and we record it as a contra-revenue.

Kim, Ben — please prepare a short customer note that includes Karthik's technical summary, the $20k credit offer (with the timebox), and a proposal call time. Marissa, please prepare the revenue memo and GL coding once the customer accepts.

I'll approve this as a strategic reference accommodation. Laura

--
Laura Bennett
VP, Commercial, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

On Tue, May 21, 2028 at 11:20 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Ben — thanks. Finance can approve up to $10k...

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 24 May 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood integration — go-live impact and next steps

Hi Samira — thanks for flagging and for the timeline. We discussed the options internally and want to keep your launch on track. Proposed path: 

1) Technical stopgap: we will route you to the fallback variant (rwd-large-2-4k-quant). Karthik has prepared a short technical note on what to expect (attached) and our engineering lead is available for a call Tuesday to walk through the changes.

2) Commercial accommodation: Redwood will provide a one-time promotional credit of $20,000 applied to your May invoice to offset the impact of the model availability gap. This is conditioned on Kestrel signing a brief acceptance acknowledging the fallback variant and the expected quality delta. The credit is timeboxed and will be treated as contra-revenue; our finance team will provide the GL coding.

If that works, can we schedule a 30-minute call Monday 10am PT to finalize the acceptance language and demo plan? I attached the acceptance draft and Karthik's technical note.

Best,
Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
